daily.message: Hi babe. Even when we are in different places, I wanted you to have a little piece of me with you. I hope this makes an ordinary day feel a bit more like us. Love you.

surprises.message: Jack, if I could pick one place to be right now, it would be next to you.
A reminder from your girlfriend: I am proud of you, especially on the days you forget to be proud of yourself.
Redeem this for one long hug the next time I see you. No expiration date.
I love all the little ordinary moments with you. Those are my favorites.

openWhen.title: You miss me
openWhen.message: Hi babe. I miss you too. Distance changes where we are, not how much you mean to me. We will have another ordinary day together soon, and I cannot wait.

openWhen.title: You have a hard day
openWhen.message: You do not have to have it all figured out today. I believe in you, and I am here for the messy days too.

openWhen.title: You need motivation
openWhen.message: Jack, remember how capable you are. One thing at a time. I am cheering for you from wherever I am.

openWhen.title: You cannot sleep
openWhen.message: Imagine we are together doing absolutely nothing. You are safe, loved, and allowed to rest. Goodnight, babe.

openWhen.title: You need to smile
openWhen.message: This is where I will put one of our ridiculous inside jokes. You know the one.
